ultimate_okoye.title: GENERAL OF THE DORA MILAJE
ultimate_okoye.text: Unwavering and lethal, Okoye commanded the battlefield, absorbing brutal damage for her allies before retaliating with deadly precision.

deck.name: Dora Milaje
deck.effect_text: Until the beginning of your next turn, if another Hero in your Location takes damage, you can take that damage instead.

deck.name: Accomplished Strategist
deck.effect_text: Reveal the top card of your deck. You may put it at the bottom of your deck.
